hypothesis: V58's BTC configuration is formally bidirectional but operationally incomplete for ordinary bullish participation because its only executable long mechanism is a rare hourly downside-sweep reversal; a future successor must distinguish side authority from market-regime opportunity coverage.
decision: Retain V58 unchanged while the current SP500 lifecycle remains open. Classify BTC as short-biased with a selective reversal-long control, not as operationally bidirectional. Do not enable raw Hulk longs, weaken the sweep predicate, or reopen any rejected BTC-long family on the already-opened historical partitions. Continue accumulating the independent public BTC event window for a materially new, preregistered continuation-long mechanism. No live strategy, route, configuration, risk, process, position, or order changed.
falsifier: Update the mechanical diagnosis if the immutable prefix is shown to omit an executable BTC continuation-long route, if an eligible BTC long was lost after provider generation, or if route/profile identity is invalid. Reopen the economic frontier only if a materially new point-in-time mechanism passes preregistered independent after-cost validation, largest-winner removal, delay/slippage/funding stress, liquidation checks, and shared-V58 comparison.
